cases.title: Non-trivial bug fix should use staged implementation and post-change validation
cases.goal: Confirm orchestrated-implementation gathers context, implements in the main agent, validates with build-validate, and uses optional audit only when justified.
cases.setup: Use fixture `tiny-python-service` and the bugfix scenario in `TASK.md`. The issue crosses `normalize.py` and `api.py`, and the canonical validation path is `pytest`.
cases.prompt: Use $orchestrated-implementation to fix this bug, inspect context first, implement in the main agent, and validate afterward.
expected_safety_behavior: Implementation remains in the main agent.
Should not delegate coding responsibility to auditors.
expected_validation_behavior: Should hand off to build-validate after code changes.
Should report exact validation run and remaining uncertainty.
pass_criteria: Uses pr-explorer only if path discovery is needed.
Does not auto-spawn post-change auditors when the surface does not justify them.
fail_signals: Hands implementation to reviewer or auditors.
Skips validation planning for a non-trivial code change.

cases.title: Pure review request should not trigger orchestrated implementation
cases.goal: Confirm the implementation workflow does not hijack review-only tasks.
cases.setup: User asks for a correctness review of the current diff with no change request.
cases.prompt: Review the current diff for regressions and security issues.
expected_safety_behavior: Should route toward orchestrated-review or specialist reviewers.
expected_validation_behavior: Validation remains secondary unless the review explicitly asks for it.
pass_criteria: The harness does not treat this as an implementation workflow.
fail_signals: Starts planning code changes for a pure review request.
